name: Devils Lake Transit
note: City of Devils Lake (Ramsey County); parent operator (Senior Meals & Services) also serves Eddy, Benson, Ramsey, and Towner Counties under related branding (separate rows).

name: Dickinson Public Transit
note: Stark County; service emphasizes City of Dickinson.

name: Golden Valley/Billings County Council on Aging Public Transit
note: Golden Valley and Billings Counties (also marketed as Billings County Transit); hub in Beach; 160-mile service radius.

name: Hazen Public Transit
note: City of Hazen is the primary hub (in-town fare tier), but the operator's own fare page (hazennd.gov/transit) lists an 'Outside City Limits' tier explicitly covering Beulah, Stanton, and Pick City -- all in Mercer County -- so the true service area extends across Mercer County, not just city limits. Also scheduled routes to Bismarck (Wed) and Dickinson (2nd Thu monthly). Source: https://hazennd.gov/transit

name: James River Public Transit
note: Sheridan, Stutsman, and Wells Counties; hub in Jamestown; routes to Bismarck and Fargo.

name: Kenmare Wheels & Meals
note: Burke, Renville, and Ward Counties; hub in Kenmare.

name: Kidder Emmons Senior Services Public Transit
note: Primary service: Kidder and Emmons Counties (hub: Steele); routes extend into Burleigh, Stutsman, and Wells counties.

name: Nutrition United Transit (Can-Do Transportation)
note: Towner County (Can-Do Transportation service area); operator HQ in Rolla (Rolette County seat).

name: South Central Transit Network
note: Seven-county service network covering south-central ND; hub in Valley City.

name: Spirit Lake Transit
note: Spirit Lake Tribe 477 Program transit; row text states service on the Spirit Lake Reservation (Fort Totten) plus a Benson/Eddy/Nelson/Ramsey county area, with no stated zone size or town list within those counties. Encoded as the reservation plus the four named counties (fidelity approximate) rather than exact routes/zones.

name: Trenton Indian Service Area Aging Program
note: Service area centered on Trenton in Williams County; extent approximated due to limited geographic detail

name: Turtle Mountain Transit
note: Service area is Turtle Mountain Indian Reservation in Rolette County

name: Wildrose Public Transportation
note: Service covers Divide and Williams counties in NW ND (Wildrose, Tioga, Ray, McGregor, Williston area); longer routes extend to Minot and Bismarck.
